findings.text: Early SNP communication area enrollment accepts a host physical address and performs a request response exchange over the secure channel MSR to enroll its frame. The caller provides only the address. Success is silent while an unexpected response category or a non echoed frame identifier ends the guest via the termination path.

Boot communication initialization is inert without encrypted state guest capability. On systems where the in kernel exception entry is already live it finalizes per processor enrollment under SNP and records completion. Otherwise during primary processor startup it validates host protocol compatibility, prepares and publishes a shared bootstrap page, and enrolls that page when SNP is present.

Protocol agreement is a single round trip that starts in an unnegotiated state, solicits host capabilities, and either remains unnegotiated on unexpected reply kind or disjoint version intervals, or moves to negotiated with a version chosen as the lower of host maximum and local maximum.

Guest host channel GPA messages carry the frame identifier in the upper bits with a page offset shift, while the low dozen bits carry the request or response discriminator. Response validation compares both the discriminator and the echoed frame value.

Channel information word reserves its lowest twelve bits for message kind, places the minimum supported protocol in bits thirty two through forty seven, and the maximum in bits forty eight through sixty three.

Secure channel MSR retrieval funnels through a native read that issues a privileged read with an associated fault recovery entry, so an access fault transfers to a defined continuation rather than unwinding as an unhandled exception.

Fault recovery records live in a dedicated table section, aligned on four bytes, each holding a source offset relative to its own location, a continuation offset relative likewise, and a numeric category.

Secondary processor parking holds the channel while cycling an announce and host exit pair with cleared auxiliary fields, staying parked until a valid wake indication with nonzero payload arrives, then releases the channel and resumes.

Offline handling has two build variants. One routes through common quiesce plus secure parking and restart, and one aliases the native path. Setup either installs the secure routine into the SMP operation vector or does nothing, matching the selected variant.

Per processor secure runtime storage is provisioned early from firmware described memory on the processor local node, with fatal failure on exhaustion. When a privileged supervisor layer is indicated, an additional call area page is provisioned per processor, reusing a bootstrap page for the first processor and recording both virtual and physical locations.

Communication page activation requires the page to be mapped without encryption, cleared, and marked inactive for both primary and backup use. One build provides a trivial success stub for the mapping primitive while the full build performs the range conversion.

Early encryption attribute changes progress over an address interval, updating fully covered table entries directly and subdividing larger mappings when coverage is partial, then notifying the host and refreshing translation caches globally. Lookup failure aborts the interval with an error indication.

Physical direct mapping alteration is offered as a narrow entry that delegates to the general initializer with standard kernel protection and non initial mode, governed by a mask that permits or forbids each large page size.

Direct mapping construction walks the top level, descending into existing subtrees when present and materializing missing intermediate tables otherwise, publishing new branches under serialization and propagating top changes to all address spaces when creation occurred.

Table publication serializes on the initial address space lock, global propagation serializes on a global list lock nested with each target address space lock, and direct page accounting uses the same global lock via scoped acquisition.

Lower level builders reuse compatible existing entries, retain large mappings when the size mask allows, otherwise replace them while preserving frame and protection apart from the large flag, allocate fresh tables for gaps, and clear entries beyond the requested end when still before allocator handoff and lacking firmware RAM or ACPI coverage.

Global propagation differs by paging depth. One depth copies top entries while the other copies next level entries under a folded top assumption. Both guard address overflow, skip empty references, enforce equality when both sides are populated, and populate empty slots.

Small page table utilities expose translation between entries and addresses or protection values, index derivation from virtual addresses, flag removal, and owner lookup from table descriptors, with paravirtual awareness for top level reads.
Direct mapping population tallies vary by build. One variant discards counts while the other accumulates per level counts under protection against concurrent attribute changes.

Early table memory comes from a single page helper that after allocator handoff uses atomic zeroed allocation with size order rounding, and before handoff prefers a reserved buffer, then firmware memory within mapped bounds, then bootstrap heap growth, failing fatally when none succeed and clearing every returned page.

Page zeroing is architecture specific. One implementation delegates to a generic fill while the other sanitizes instrumentation state first and then selects between an unrolled routine and optimized string operations based on processor capabilities.

Several mismatches are fatal. Unexpected enrollment echo, unsupported host protocol, failed runtime or call area provisioning, failed decryption mapping, and divergent global top entries across address spaces all abort. Mapping changes also require a global translation refresh because the range rebuilder itself does not flush.
